title: Normalization from Plates with a Single-Channel Pipette
author: Breakthrough Genomics
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Create Volumes CSV
steps.instruction:
Prepare a CSV file named “Volumes CSV” containing columns sample, vol_dna, vol_water. Format each row as shown: ```sample,vol_dna,vol_water
A1,23.4,11.6
B1,4.9,21.1
C1,21.6,4.4
D1,15.1,10.9
E1,19.1,6.9
F1,18.6,7.4
G1,10.7,15.3
H1,21.9,4.1
A2,19.1,6.9
B2,0.4,25.6
C2,24.0,2.0
D2,6.1,19.9
E2,10.7,15.3
F2,24.2,1.8
G2,6.1,19.9
H2,3.0,23.0
...``` covering up to 96 samples.

steps.title: Enter Protocol Parameters
steps.instruction: Input the protocol parameters (including the Volumes CSV) in the provided fields of the Opentrons protocol builder.

steps.title: Download and Unzip Protocol
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol package and unzip it if required before proceeding.

steps.title: Upload Custom Labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select any required labware definition files with a .json extension.

steps.title: Upload Protocol File
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol script file (with a .py extension) to the OT App via the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set Up Deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the supplied deck map, placing plates, tip racks, and other labware in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate Labware and Pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App’s calibration workflow; use calibration tips as described in the support articles.

steps.title: Run Protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the normalization protocol.
